**Test image analysis:**
- Tomato leaf with a large, irregular dark brown necrotic lesion covering most of the leaf
- Dark brown/black center with lighter brown edges
- Surrounding yellowing (chlorosis) around the lesion margins
- Some water-soaked/greasy texture to the necrosis
- Lesion spreads from the leaf edge inward

**Comparison with Late Blight reference:**
The reference image matches closely — large irregular dark brown necrotic area consuming much of the leaf surface, with remaining green tissue. The test image adds peripheral yellowing, consistent with the rapid progression of *Phytophthora infestans*. The pattern, coloration, and necrotic spread are hallmarks of Late Blight.
